# Taxonomy of Grid-Based Logic Games

## I. PLACEMENT GAMES
Games where you place objects, numbers, or marks in cells

### I.A. Light/Illumination
- **Akari** - Place light bulbs that illuminate rows/columns

### I.B. Number Placement
- **Sudoku** - Place numbers 1-9 in rows, columns, and blocks
- **Nansuke** - Fill blank cells with numbers from a list
- **Makaro** - Fill cells with numbers based on directional arrow constraints
- **Ripple Effect** - Fill rooms with consecutive numbers starting from 1
- **Kurotto** - Color cells based on number constraints in circles

### I.C. Shape/Block Placement
- **Shikaku** - Divide grid into rectangles containing one number
- **Evolomino** - Place squares on arrows with progressive block growth
- **Pencils** - Mark pencils and draw lines from tips using numbers
- **Sashigane** - Divide grid into L-shaped blocks with marked knees

### I.D. Circle/Object Movement
- **Satogaeri** - Move circles so each country contains one circle
- **Yosenabe** - Move circles into gray areas with sum constraints

## II. COLORING/SHADING GAMES
Games where you color or shade cells

### II.A. Black Cell Placement
- **Kurodoko** - Color cells black based on number constraints
- **Hitori** - Color cells to eliminate duplicate numbers in rows/columns
- **Nurikabe** - Color cells black to form continuous walls
- **Usowan** - Color cells with one wrong number per region
- **Sto-stone** - Color cells that "drop" to fill bottom half of grid
- **Tilepaint** - Color tiles based on diagonal number constraints
- **Norinori** - Color cells in pairs within regions

### II.B. Mixed Coloring
- **Nuritwin** - Shade two equal-sized blocks per region
- **Shakashaka** - Place black triangles leaving white rectangles/squares
- **Nurimeizu** - Paint cells to create maze from S to G
- **Nurimisaki** - Color cells with white "promontories" and constraints
- **LITS** - Color four-cell tetrominoes per region

## III. LINE-DRAWING GAMES
Games where you draw lines to form loops or paths

### III.A. Single Loop Games
- **Masyu** - Loop through white and black circles with turn rules
- **Slitherlink** - Connect dots with lines based on number constraints
- **Dotchi-Loop** - Loop through white circles with area-based turn rules
- **Moon-or-Sun** - Loop through rooms alternating moon/sun cells
- **Yajilin** - Loop avoiding black cells indicated by arrows
- **Nagareru** - Loop following directional arrows with wind constraints
- **Suraromu** - Loop starting/ending at numbered circle, passing gates
- **Mid-loop** - Loop with black circles as midpoints of line segments

### III.B. Path/Connection Games
- **Numberlink** - Connect pairs of same numbers with continuous lines
- **Hashiwokakero** - Connect islands with bridges based on numbers

## IV. DIVISION/PARTITIONING GAMES
Games where you divide the grid into regions or blocks

### IV.A. Block Division with Numbers
- **Fillomino** - Divide grid into blocks matching their numbers
- **Five Cells** - Divide into five-cell blocks with line constraints
- **Chained Block** - Create blocks with numbers/question marks in chains
- **Double Choco** - Divide into blocks with matching white/gray pairs

### IV.B. Block Division with Shapes
- **Choco Banana** - Divide into rectangles/squares with number constraints

### IV.C. Room-Based Division
- **Heyawake** - Paint cells in rooms with connectivity constraints
- **Ripple Effect** - Fill rooms with consecutive numbers

## V. HYBRID/COMPLEX GAMES
Games combining multiple mechanics

- **Hebi** - Place sequential numbers (1-5) forming snakes with constraints
- **Juosan** - Fill cells with dashes/pipes with extension limits
- **Shikaku** - Divide grid into rectangles containing one number each

---

## Summary by Primary Mechanic

| Mechanic | Count | Examples |
|----------|-------|----------|
| Line Drawing (Loops) | 8 | Masyu, Slitherlink, Yajilin, etc. |
| Coloring/Shading | 11 | Kurodoko, Hitori, Nurikabe, etc. |
| Number Placement | 4 | Sudoku, Nansuke, Makaro, Ripple Effect |
| Block/Shape Placement | 4 | Shikaku, Evolomino, Pencils, Sashigane |
| Block Division | 4 | Fillomino, Five Cells, Chained Block, Double Choco |
| Movement | 2 | Satogaeri, Yosenabe |
| Hybrid | 3 | Hebi, Juosan, Shikaku |
